meshy.prompt_template: Low poly stylized {description}. Game-ready first-person shooter weapon for Roblox, clean simple geometry with flat-shaded faces, neutral color scheme of dark gunmetal grey and black polymer with subtle olive accents, no logos, no text, no hands, single isolated object, pointing forward.
